newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish net reserves fall to $21.25 bln in Mar 1-20.
newsitem.headline: Polish net reserves fall to $21.25 bln in Mar 1-20.

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves fell by $297 million in March 1-20 to $21.25 billion and were $787 million lower than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said on Wednesday.
Net reserves fell $418 million since the start of 1997.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) MARCH 20 FEBRUARY MARCH 1996
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
